This is an increase from the previous cycle, and I want to understand what's driving this uptick. While there are only four named individuals on the hospital and cause records, I’ll explore the broader neighborhood context—how families are coping, who’s covering shifts when someone falls ill, and what the walk to the clinic looks like. I’ll avoid diagnosing beyond what’s on the record and keep the human cost at the center.
